title: The Blue Hour Club
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Every dusk, four strangers gather on the sea wall of Pelican Point to watch the light leave: a retired astronomer, a grief counselor, a fisherman\'s daughter, and a man who has stopped speaking. Over one long summer, the blue hour becomes a church, and the four must decide what they are watching for.
